pawncounter.description: a pawn shop glass jewellery display counter full of gold rings, chains and watches, a small cash register and a pile of old mobile phones on top, steel frame

tvstack.description: a wobbly stack of second-hand televisions, games consoles and DVD players with handwritten price tags, on a wooden pallet

guitarrack.description: a pawn shop rack of second-hand electric guitars and an acoustic guitar standing in a row, price tags hanging off them

bikerack.description: three second-hand bicycles leaning in a metal rack with cardboard price signs
